screened_out.meaning: no Earth window at this target's MOLA scale (sea or no DEM)

no_data.meaning: no valid elevation, or land cover unknown for half the windows (outside WorldCover)

ground_hidden.meaning: half the windows or more hidden by forest, crops, buildings, water, wetland, mangroves, snow or ice

partial.meaning: fewer than half the windows of the cell are valid for this target

low_confidence.meaning: not high confidence: under 80% of the cell's windows valid, or 10% or more masked or of unknown cover

evaluated.meaning: high confidence: at least 80% of the cell's windows valid and under 10% masked or of unknown cover
